# orchestration_cluster_cluster_topology (Data Source)

Exposes the status and topology of a Camunda cluster. See the Camunda documentation on [cluster administration](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/cluster-admin/).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) The cluster Id
- `cluster_size` (Number) The number of brokers in the cluster.
- `gateway_version` (String) The version of the Zeebe Gateway.
- `partitions_count` (Number) The number of partitions are spread across the cluster.
- `replication_factor` (Number) The configured replication factor for this cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster Id
